en.title: Disney+ and Hulu Just Raised Prices Again: Here's What It Means
en.summary: The streaming giants have implemented another price hike, pushing ad-free plans to $21.49 per month. This marks the fourth increase in four years, impacting millions of subscribers across the US.
en.body:
The familiar sting of a price increase is back for **Disney+** and **Hulu** subscribers. In a move that’s becoming a predictable annual event, the Walt Disney Company has once again raised the monthly subscription fees for its flagship streaming platforms in the U.S., effective immediately for new sign-ups. This latest adjustment, which took effect on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, marks the fourth time in just four years that the company has increased rates, a trend that began in October 2024 and continued through October 2023.

For those who prefer an uninterrupted viewing experience, the ad-free "Premium" plans have seen a significant jump of $2.50, bringing the monthly cost to a steep $21.49. Meanwhile, the ad-supported tiers, while less affected, have also inched up by 50 cents, now costing $12.49 per month. This ongoing escalation in pricing reflects the immense pressure on streaming services to achieve profitability in an increasingly competitive market, even as they continue to invest heavily in original content and licensing deals.

## The Fan Fallout: More Than Just a Number

For dedicated binge-watchers and fans of **Disney+**'s vast library of family-friendly content, **Hulu**'s critically acclaimed dramas, and the FX on **Hulu** offerings, these price hikes are more than just a line item on a budget. It’s a direct impact on their access to beloved shows and movies. The question on many fans' minds is whether the continued investment in original programming, such as upcoming seasons of **"The Mandalorian"** or the latest Marvel series, justifies the escalating cost. With each increase, the line between traditional cable bundles and premium streaming becomes blurrier, prompting subscribers to re-evaluate their subscriptions and potentially cut back on services. The community chatter online often centers on the perceived value proposition: are the exclusive shows and films worth the premium? This latest hike undoubtedly intensifies that debate.

## What's Next on the Horizon

While details regarding future price adjustments or the introduction of new subscription tiers have not yet been announced, this pattern suggests that further increases are likely. Subscribers will be watching closely to see how these financial decisions align with the content pipeline. The upcoming releases and potential renewal stakes for popular series will undoubtedly play a crucial role in how fans perceive the value of their **Disney+** and **Hulu** subscriptions moving forward.

content_raw: Standalone subscription prices rise to US$12.49 with ads, US$21.49 without ads following last year's increase
